direction: Date-and-place card. Early-morning establishing still of the farmhouse and yard, April 1881: stone house, limewashed walls, yard muck and puddles, a cart against the barn, smoke from the kitchen chimney. Slow push-in toward the kitchen door. Ambience only: hens, a distant dog, wind in bare hedges. About 8 seconds.
